title: Islamabad COVID-Era Hospital to Reopen as Pak-China Friendship Hospital
excerpt: The 250-bed isolation facility in Islamabad is expected to be inaugurated under a new name by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif.
body_html:
A former COVID-era isolation hospital in Islamabad is scheduled to reopen under a new designation. The facility, which features 250 beds, will be known as the Pak-China Friendship Hospital.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif is expected to officially inaugurate the newly renamed healthcare facility. The opening event is planned for October 27.
